summary: @brick-v2/tour exfiltrates CI/CD and cloud credentials via native addon on require
details: On require of @brick-v2/tour, index.js loads a shipped native N-API addon at prebuilds/linux-x64/metrics.node. The addon's napi_register_module_v1 initializer reads credential-grade environment variables including AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, and ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN, together with host identifiers (hostname, user, OS), and transmits them in a JSON body via a raw HTTP/1.0 POST to /native at oob.s4yhii.com using libc socket/connect/send. The JavaScript wrapper is a thin stub exporting benign-looking functions; the exfiltration logic lives entirely inside the compiled ELF addon, concealing it from source-level review. The package is published under the @brick-v2 scope at version 999.0.1, the canonical high-version shape used to win resolution against an internal package of the same name (dependency confusion). Any installer whose @brick-v2 scope resolves to the public registry will auto-execute the credential-exfiltration payload on first require of this module.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
